basic_details.job_title: ICAR CIAE Recruitment 2026 – Walkin for 15 Young Professional, Senior Research Fellow Posts
basic_details.short_information: ICAR-Central Institute of Agricultural Engineering (Bharatiya Krishi Anusandhan Parishad - Kendriya Krishi Abhiyantriki Sansthan), Bhopal will hold walk-in interviews on different dates from 26 November 2026 to 16 December 2026, each at 10:00 AM, at ICAR- Central Institute of Agricultural Engineering, Nabi Bagh, Berasia Road, Bhopal. The interviews are for 15 posts under various projects, schemes and sections of the institute: Young Professional-I (6 posts), Young Professional-I (IT) (1), Young Professional-II (4), Young Professional-II (IT) (1) and Senior Research Fellow (3). The pay is Rs.30

content_sections.heading: About ICAR-CIAE
content_sections.text: ICAR-Central Institute of Agricultural Engineering (ICAR-CIAE) is an institute of the Indian Council of Agricultural Research located at Nabi Bagh, Berasia Road, Bhopal- 462 038 (Madhya Pradesh). Its letterhead describes it as an ISO 9001:2015 Certified Institute. These posts serve its Establishment & Recruitment Section, Library Section, Agricultural Knowledge Management Unit, Farm Machinery Training and Testing Centre and several research projects, including projects under the "Mission for Cotton Productivity (Kapas Kanti)", the Central Corpus Fund-Indian Council of Agricultural Research (CCF ICAR) - National Priority Project (NPP), and a Global Network project with ICAR-Indian Institute of Millet research Hyderabad.

content_sections.heading: What to Bring
content_sections.text: Bio-data containing particulars of age, qualification, subjects taken, year of passing, marks obtained and address proof, with a photograph pasted on the top right side of the application/bio-data. Original certificates and their attested copies. Relevant publications (if any). Experience certificate in original, if any. No-Objection Certificate (NOC) of the present employer, for persons already employed.

content_sections.heading: What Happens on the Day
content_sections.text: Candidates report at 10:00 AM on the date fixed for their post at the institute in Nabi Bagh, Berasia Road, Bhopal. A written test may be conducted before the oral interview for the post. A candidate will not be permitted to appear in the interview without original certificates of educational qualifications. No TA/DA is admissible for attending the interview.

faq.question: Q1. When are the ICAR-CIAE walk-in interviews in 2026?
faq.answer: The interviews run on separate dates for each post from 26 November 2026 to 16 December 2026, starting with Young Professional-I (Establishment & Recruitment Section) on 26 November and ending with Young Professional-I (IT) for AKMU on 16 December.

faq.question: Q2. What is the reporting time and venue?
faq.answer: Every interview is at 10:00 AM at ICAR- Central Institute of Agricultural Engineering, Nabi Bagh, Berasia Road, Bhopal.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are there in ICAR-CIAE Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 15 posts: Young Professional-I (6), Young Professional-I (IT) (1), Young Professional-II (4), Young Professional-II (IT) (1) and Senior Research Fellow (3).

faq.question: Q4. What qualification is needed for Senior Research Fellow?
faq.answer: A Master degree in Farm Machinery and Power (FMP) with 4 years / 5 years of Bachelor's Degree in Agricultural/Mechanical Engineering having 1st division or at least 60% marks or equivalent overall grade point average.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit?
faq.answer: For Senior Research Fellow, the maximum is 35 years for men and 40 years for women; for Young Professional-I & II, the minimum is 21 years and the maximum 45 years.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary for Young Professional posts?
faq.answer: Young Professional-I gets Rs.30,000/- and Young Professional-II gets Rs.42,000/- consolidated per month.

faq.question: Q7. Is HRA paid on top of the pay?
faq.answer: HRA is mentioned only for Senior Research Fellow, whose pay is Rs.37,000/- + HRA consolidated per month.

faq.question: Q8. What documents should I bring to the interview?
faq.answer: Bring a bio-data with photograph pasted on the top right, original certificates with attested copies, relevant publications (if any), original experience certificate (if any), and an NOC if you are already employed.

faq.question: Q9. How will candidates be selected?
faq.answer: Selection is by oral interview, and a written test may be conducted before the oral interview for the post.

faq.question: Q10. Are these permanent jobs?
faq.answer: No. The posts are purely time bound/non-regular temporary/contractual engagement, co-terminus with the concerned project, with no right to absorption or regularization at ICAR-CIAE or any other ICAR Institute.
